en.html:
We had taken Muramasa's Divine Art—
Endured it. Then Masamune's Divine Art had hit it back.

The Divine Art of Immediate Retribution.
To reproduce the attack inflicted on itself and drive it into the opponent: the very essence of Soushuu Masamune.

Which meant that draw—the lightning itself—must have struck Muramasa's own body...

身に浴びたはずだ……。

en.html:
In that case, wouldn't we have gone down before we could return it?

...For one moment I thought that. Then I put it right.

No. we cannot be brought down.

Can't be brought down, so the enemy's trump card is ours for the taking. Always. This Divine Art is the strongest move there is.

No problem.
Masamune doesn't fall, so where is the problem?

Someone carrying justice doesn't fall!

Whatever the wounds.
Even... even when the person I trusted betrays me.

ja.html:
その場合、返す前にこっちが墜とされたんじゃない
のか。
　
　……一瞬だけそう思って、すぐに思い直す。

　そんなことはない。
　<ruby>正宗<rt>あたしたち</rt></ruby>は<ruby>絶対に倒れない<rt>・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>。

　倒れないから、つまり必ず敵の切り札を奪い取れる。
　この陰義は間違いなく最強の一手だ。

　問題は無い。
　正宗は倒れないのだから問題など無い。

　正義を背負う者は倒れないのだから！
　
　どれほどの傷を受けても、
　たとえ――信じた人に裏切られても。
